statement.p: Let f(x,y,z)=x+yz and let \mathcal{C} be the line segment from P=(0,0,0) to (6,4,1).
(a) Calculate f(\mathbf{c}(t)) and \,ds=\Vert \mathbf{c}'(t)\Vert\,dt for the parametrization \mathbf{c}(t)=(6 t,4 t,1 t) for 0\le t \le 1.

static.solution: (a) We substitute x=6 t, y=4 t, z=1 t in the function f( x,y,z )=x+yz to find f\left(\mathbf{c}(t)\right): f\left(\mathbf{c}(t)\right)=6 t+( 4 t )( 1 t )=6 t+4 t^2 We differentiate the vector \mathbf{c}(t) and compute the length of the derivative vector: {\mathbf{c}}'(t)=\frac{d}{dt}\left\lt 6 t,4 t,1 t \right> = \left\lt 6,4,1 \right>\quad\Rightarrow\quad {\| \mathbf{c}}'(t) \|=\sqrt{{6}^2+ {4}^2+ {1}^2}=\sqrt{53} Hence, ds=\| {\mathbf{c}}'(t)\| \,dt=\sqrt{53} \,dt (b) Computing the scalar line integral, we obtain \int_{\mathcal{C}} f( x,y,z ) \,ds =\int_0^1 f\left(\mathbf{c}(t)\right)\| {\mathbf{c}}'(t)\| \,dt =\int_0^1 (6t+4t^{2})\cdot \sqrt{53} \,dt= \sqrt{53}\left(3 t^2+\frac{4}3 t^3\right)\bigg|_0^1 =\sqrt{53}\left(3+\frac{4}3\right)= \frac{13 \sqrt{53}}{3} \approx 31.5471
